title: OpenAI, Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL announce strategic content partnership
summary_lines: OpenAI partners with Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to bring trusted Brazilian journalism to ChatGPT, expanding access to news with attribution and transparency.
